title: Pitstop Books
body:
O.P.
Does anyone know what happened to Pitstop Books ?
I bought quite a few technical books from them over the years, then a couple of years ago, they were gone
They were fantastic for motorcycle and car books, maybe someone can recommend an alternate shop

Does anyone know what happened to Pitstop Books ?
They used to have B&M stores but they closed awhile back and they moved totally online, but that also closed down a couple of years ago. Closing down sale was advertised on some of the motorsport forums. No real reason given:
